translation: I say this is the heart of the Way, and can be spoken to those who are bright and able to think. If one is obscured by accumulation, one cannot even restore the human heart; how could one have leisure to discuss the heart of the Way? I previously regretted that those limited by their heavenly endowment had no method of governing the heart; now for the first time I have obtained the method. Remove the accumulation and the heart can become bright again, and there is nothing that thinking cannot obtain. If one can truly rub, the five phases have no obstruction, mutually nourishing and mutually generating, the hundred joints are freed, the ten thousand orifices are exquisite, the heavenly ruler is calm, and the four limbs follow orders; though foolish, one must become bright, and though weak, one must become strong. What is called cultivating the self lies in rectifying the heart.
